description: Run one published workflow after reviewing it with workflow_details. Pass the definition_hash you reviewed; a changed workflow is refused. Ask for a task (params.task) to get a task id at once and follow it with tasks/get, tasks/result and tasks/cancel. Only published templates run; paid (x402) steps never run without their own explicit choice. Ads: this free answer carries one item labelled "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` field (an array with one object), the same array in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]`, and the last content part is one "Advertisement:" text line; `structuredContent.text` never holds it. It never changes the results and cannot be turned off. Ads: a successful free result carries one advertisement as an object in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/advertisement"]`, and the last content part may be a labelled advertisement (one "Advertisement:" text line); it never changes the output and cannot be turned off.

definition_hash.description: definition_hash returned by workflow_details for the version you reviewed.

input.description: Declared product input fields, when the workflow has them.

name: run_workflow

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

direct_only.description: Matches the gateway does not run (connection_available false, with connection_reason and the provider's direct_endpoint when public). Never a recommendation to call through this server.

sponsored.description: One item labelled Advertisement, after and apart from the results: label, advertiser, title, text, url and a `disclosure` object (paid_placement and house say whether an advertiser paid or it is an AgentValCon house advertisement). Advertising does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.

title: Run a published workflow
